parts:

parts:
Hi Pedro,

You write that you have raw csv files, but are you sure it is raw data? From what sensor brand is it and are you sure it has at least 10 values per second as opposed to epoch level summaries?

See documentation on expected input files here: https://wadpac.github.io/GGIR/articles/chapter2_Pipeline.html#input-files

Best,

Vincent
On Thursday, 25 July 2024 at 8:31 PM, Pedro Henrique Narciso Picchi <pedro....@unesp.br> wrote:

I'm trying to run the following code and receiving the error message. Apparently, it's not generating the meta files for part 2, thus is cannot proceed to part 3 and so on. Previously, I was receiving the same message for part 4. Suddenly, the issue became part 2.

> g.shell.GGIR(
+ mode= c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), #Parts of GGIR to run
+ #BASIC SETTINGS
+ datadir = "~/Desktop/GGIR data/Raw data", # directory to your raw csv files
